criterion: Dense charts should not flood the tab order
description: The usage page exposes hundreds of individual chart bars as focusable buttons before users reach the aggregate summaries and settings-adjacent controls.
expected: The chart should provide an efficient keyboard pattern, such as a single focusable chart region with roving focus, grouped range controls, or a separate accessible data table.
actual: The page exposed 289 buttons, most of them empty visible-text date-bar controls like `Usage for Mon, Jun 22, 2026`.
suggested_fix: Redesign the chart interaction so date bars do not all appear in the normal tab order while preserving pointer filtering and accessible date selection.
